thread:
Sam (Sales): Contoso Signals ready to sign but procurement attached MSA+DPA redlines and a KMS/CMK request for Hosted. They want monthly commit billing too. @Priya @Dmitri please advise.
Priya (Legal): Share redlines. Short take: we do not allow customer CMKs on Hosted multi-tenant. Will propose Dedicated/Private path or a documented Security Exception if they insist.
Sam (Sales): Uploaded contoso_redlines_v2.pdf and security_questionnaire.xlsx. They also want 10% off for 12mo commit and net60.
Ava (Finance): At $22k/mo commit our discount cap is 6% and standard terms net30. Net60+10% needs RevOps/CRO escalation. Could do net45+7% if Security allows Dedicated.
Dmitri (Security): CMKs on Hosted = operational risk. If they accept Dedicated tenancy + key-policy restrictions + audit-forwarding + quarterly attestations, we can approve. Require documented runbook and emergency revoke. No CMKs on Hosted.
June (Sales Ops): DocuSign signer order requested: PO -> Contoso Legal -> Sam (Sales) -> Priya (Legal). Need final PDFs and signer emails. Also note: add "Provisional acceptance - pending Security Exception" stamp per legal.
Priya (Legal): I'll draft a redline response: reject broad indemnities and global data transfer clauses; add clause: "Customer CMKs permitted only on Dedicated or Private. Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys unless Security Exception approved."
Sam (Sales): Contoso insists Hosted for speed. I'll present two options: 1) Hosted w/ Redwood-managed keys and standard pricing; 2) Dedicated w/ CMKs, net45+7% and 48-72h provisioning.
Dmitri (Security): If they pick Dedicated, provisioning and capacity allocation required; SLA 99.95 needs reserved nodes => ~20% uplift. We'll provide an exception template and checklist.
Ava (Finance): If Dedicated accepted, I can sign off net45/7% at ~$22k/mo. Otherwise escalate for net60/10%.
doc-bot: uploaded: dedicated_cost_estimate.csv -> https://files.redwood.com/dedicated_cost_estimate.csv :white_check_mark:
Sam (Sales): I'll send options and draft DocuSign envelope tonight with provisional watermark. Thanks all.
Priya (Legal): Add a Legal note to the envelope: "provisional acceptance; final sign-off only after Security Exception completed and operational onboarding confirmed."
June (Sales Ops): I'll prepare the envelope when you drop the PDFs and signer emails. Reminder set to follow up in 48h. :alarm_clock:
